title: Open Camping DB photo
description: One line of photos/<place id>.ndjson: a traveller's photo of a place. The files are served as <id>/full.jpg and <id>/thumb.jpg. No names, emails or device IDs, and no key outside this schema.

contributor.description: Opaque id of the account that took the photo, as on reviews: ctr_ and 16 hex characters.

app.description: Short name of the app that sent the photo.

licence.description: The photo is the contributor's own work, licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. It is not covered by the database licence.

width.description: Pixel width of the full size file.

height.description: Pixel height of the full size file.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the full size file, lower case hex.

hidden.description: The photo is kept for the record but left out of the release and not served. reported: three contributors reported it and a person has not decided yet. moderator: a person hid it.
